svg.aria-label: AWS icon architecture diagram: human Entra JWT through AWS API Gateway, Lambda, AgentCore Runtime U and human Gateway G1 to four end systems; AWS Reporter scheduled IAM Runtime M and G2, plus separate Entra Automation Client JWT to G1 to aggregate Network API.
svg.text: Enterprise GenAI PoC — AWS AgentCore identity and tool access
Five human users + two non-human callers · JWT/IAM trust boundaries · per-target outbound credentials
Human flow — Microsoft Entra JWT / AgentCore Gateway G1 CUSTOM_JWT
G1 targets — human and registered Entra-app JWTs; outbound identities differ
G1: Human OBO assets/tickets; app-only summary; vendor 3LO; platform IAM.
AWS Reporter — IAM Runtime M / Gateway G2 AWS_IAM
G2 calls the SAME Network Operations API for aggregate summary using app-only OAuth 2LO.
James → OpenAPI → Entra OBO → Network API knows James → RLS enforces VIC only.
Oliver → native API Gateway REST stage → IAM/SigV4 → Platform API knows Gateway execution role (Cedar checked Oliver first).
Separate Entra Automation Client — no human, no AWS IAM inbound
Entra service principal → app-only JWT → Runtime U / G1 → app-only OpenAPI summary target
→ new Network API OAuth token (same app, different audience) → existing health-summary endpoint and RDS
